title: VTC Networks — Notice — payload
description: A network's broadcast, passed on to a member of the community group registered for the network's role. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

network.description: The network the community received the broadcast from.

role.description: The network's role the group serves.

groupId.description: The community group the recipient is in.

envelope.description: The network's envelope, unchanged: the message signed by the network that originated it, and one hop signed by each network that relayed it.

message.description: The originating network's signed broadcast message.

hops.description: The signed relay hops, the first by the originating network, the last delivering to the community's group.
